message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Simplified)** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house‑rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn (must be played only if you have no matching card). | | **If You Can’t Play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before your turn ends. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
Winner’s score = sum of opponents’ points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach the target score (e.g., 500) wins the game. | **House‑Rule Variations** - *Stacking*: Some players allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards. - *No “Wild Draw Four” rule*: Some groups forbid playing Wild Draw Four unless you have no other playable card. - *Different scoring thresholds*: 300, 1000, etc. Enjoy playing Uno!
